```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Executive Summary

This report analyzes the sales performance of **Widgets A, B, and C** across different regions.

## Data Loading

We load the cleaned dataset prepared by our validaton pipeline.

```{r load_data}
df <- read_csv("data/clean_sales.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
glimpse(df)
```

## Sales Performance

We observed the following trends in our sales data:

```{r sales_plot, echo=FALSE}
# We can run code directly inside the report
df |> 
  group_by(Region) |> 
  summarise(Sales = sum(Sales)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Region, y = Sales, fill = Region)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Sales by Region") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Conclusion

*   **Widget C** appears to be our best performer in the North region.
*   **Widget B** has consistent sales in the West.
